title: 第11章 第一次上课第12章 炼丹炉的关卡
slug: 修仙我觉醒了美食系统
content_zh:
林江月听见张大虎关门声便知他回来，从灶台转到他房门。
“师父，你回来啦，锅里温着饭，我给你添一碗？”
没等张大虎回绝，热腾腾的米饭已经端到跟前。
张大虎卸下疲态，笑脸盈盈看着桌上的灵米饭、清炒灵菜，还有一壶酒。
“你哪弄来的酒？”
林江月没有回话，而是坐到对面给自己斟上一杯，抢先一饮而尽。
【食材：灵酒】
【灵力上限提高：500800】
【觉醒天赋：可探查毒性范围方圆五里】
好久没有喝酒，这原身竟还有些不适。
酒醉微微一颤，她身上汗毛便立刻竖起，无数灵气由毛发侵入丹田。
张大虎感觉到周围灵力波动似浪涌般抽离奔向林江月。
稳了稳身形，才勉强不被撼动。
看着眼前面色红晕眼神迷离的小姑娘就要倒下，快速施法让她稳住心神。
一股清凉的灵气穿过神识，林江月从微醺的状态中清醒。
“这酒，这身子，居然会醉，想当当……”
话说到嘴边，林江月赶紧止住。
想当年她可是千杯不倒啊。
“想当什么？”
“哈哈哈，想当师父的跟屁虫！你去哪我就去哪！”

被眼前这个九岁女娃哄得开心，张大虎抬眉嘴笑，竟短暂忘记这几日愁苦，给自己也倒上一杯。
“你还没说，酒从哪里来的？”
“我拿你给的下品培元丹、灵石换的。”
张大虎皱眉。
以他身家平时也舍不得买酒，这小丫头居然为了他舍了全部积蓄。
“这酒贵，以后别买了。”
林江月摇了摇头举杯对撞。
“今朝有酒今朝醉，明日愁来明日愁”
“我干了，你随意。”
“好一个今朝有酒今朝醉。”
饭后，张大虎脸色微醺将林江月扶进房中，自己则收拾好桌面，就着阴冷的月色，拿出中品炼丹房的花名册、弟子信息，细细琢磨。
次日张大虎早早出门，留下一袋新米，一张纸条便走了。
“以后不用这么辛苦做饭，多点时间练功，这是新米灵力充沛，你多吃些。”
看着字条，林江月知道自己的心意没有白费。
世道虽坚，真情可贵。
她与张大虎亦师亦友。
当下环境紧张，自当共同进退，帮他亦是帮己。
将米收好，林江月去找徐惊云解释“洗尘镜”，得知确实只进不出，有些懊恼。
之后，林江月又问了中品丹房清理与下品丹房清理的价格差异。
得知下品炼丹房收入高，是因为丹渣毒性是中品丹房五倍。

林江月惊叹之余，却对徐惊云有几分钦佩。
想到如此剧毒还能他还能淡然处之，自是有什么过人之处。
林江月看了看令牌上发布的学堂消息，今日有关丹炉构造的课令她十分感兴趣。
content_en:
Lin Jiangyue knew Zhang Dahu was back when she heard Zhang Dahu closing the door, and turned from the stove to the door of his room.
"Master, you are back. The rice is warm in the pot. Can I give you a bowl?"
Before Zhang Dahu could refuse, the hot rice was brought to him.
Zhang Dahu relieved himself of his fatigue and looked at the spiritual rice, stir-fried vegetables and a pot of wine on the table with a smile on his face.
"Where did you get the wine?"
Lin Jiangyue didn't reply, but sat across from him, poured herself a glass, and drank it all in one gulp.
[Ingredients: Spiritual Wine]
[Increase the upper limit of spiritual power: 500800]
[Awakening talent: can detect poison within a radius of five miles]
It had been a long time since he had drank, and the original body was still feeling a little unwell.
When she was drunk and trembling slightly, the hairs on her body immediately stood up, and countless spiritual energy invaded her Dantian from the hairs.
Zhang Dahu felt the surrounding spiritual energy fluctuate like a surge and rushed towards Lin Jiangyue.
He stabilized his body and barely managed to avoid being shaken.
Seeing that the little girl with a red face and blurred eyes was about to fall down, he quickly cast a spell to steady her mind.
A cool spiritual energy passed through his consciousness, and Lin Jiangyue woke up from his drunken state.
"This wine, this body, can actually make me drunk. I want to..."
When the words came to her lips, Lin Jiangyue quickly stopped.
I think back then she could drink a thousand cups.
"What do you want to be?"
"Hahaha, I want to be Master's follower! I will go wherever you go!"
Being coaxed happily by the nine-year-old girl in front of him, Zhang Dahu raised his eyebrows and smiled. He temporarily forgot about the sorrow of the past few days and poured himself a glass.
"You haven't said yet, where did the wine come from?"
"I exchanged it for the low-grade Peiyuan Pill and Spirit Stone you gave me."
Zhang Dahu frowned.
With his wealth, he would usually be reluctant to buy wine, but this little girl actually gave up all her savings for him.
"This wine is expensive, don't buy it again."
Lin Jiangyue shook her head and raised her glasses.
"If you have wine today, you will be drunk today, and you will be worried tomorrow."
"I did it, you can do whatever you want."
"It's a good one. If you have wine today, you will get drunk today."
After the meal, Zhang Dahu helped Lin Jiangyue into the room with a slightly tipsy look on his face. He cleared the table and took out the roster of the middle-grade alchemy room and the disciple information under the cold moonlight, pondering it carefully.
Zhang Dahu went out early the next day, leaving a bag of new rice and a note before leaving.
"You don't have to work so hard to cook in the future and spend more time practicing. This new rice is full of spiritual energy. Eat more."
Looking at the note, Lin Jiangyue knew that her thoughts were not in vain.
Although the world is strong, true love is precious.
She and Zhang Dahu are both teachers and friends.
The current environment is tense, so we should advance and retreat together. Helping him is also helping yourself.
After putting the rice away, Lin Jiangyue went to Xu Jingyun to explain the "dust-washing mirror" and was a little annoyed when she learned that it was indeed only possible to enter but not to exit.
After that, Lin Jiangyue asked about the price difference between cleaning a middle-grade alchemy room and cleaning a low-grade alchemy room.
I learned that the income from low-grade alchemy rooms is high because the poisonous elixir slag is five times that of mid-grade alchemy rooms.
Lin Jiangyue was amazed, but she also admired Xu Jingyun.
Thinking that he could still deal with such a poisonous thing indifferently, there must be something special about him.
Lin Jiangyue looked at the school information posted on the token, and she was very interested in today's lesson about the structure of the alchemy furnace.
